about: Get-ChatqWatcherLaunch (src/watcher.ps1), PowerShell branch: {psExe, script, logDir, claude, codex} -> {exe, args, command}; args end with -EncodedCommand base64(UTF-16LE(command)). claude and codex are CHATQ_CLAUDE and CHATQ_CODEX, null for unset; the log file is Join-Path logDir watcher.log, as Windows PowerShell joins
